description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF10 allies are alive, grants [Double Sphere Mode III (Fire, Dark)], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [100% Critical (25s)] to the user

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Double Sphere Mode III (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
